class.name: ShapeQueryResult
class.brief_description: A packed result instance for a [ShapeQuery3DDirect].
class.description: A packed result instance for a [ShapeQuery3DDirect]. When reused (that is, an instance is created and shared across many casts), this can be significantly more optimized than the traditional [Dictionary] return value.

members.member: The [GodotObject] attached to the collider. Typically this is a [PhysicsBody3D] or [Area3D], but the engine allows any object to be associated with a physics object. Note that some physics objects might be made custom, and not have an object assigned to them, making this [code]nil[/code] even if there was a hit.

The object ID of the [member collider]. Note that this may be set to a custom value that does not correspond to an object ID; if this is nonzero but [member collider] is [code]nil[/code], it likely corresponds to some custom object lookup.
The [RID] of the physics object that got hit. Unlike [member collider] and [member collider_id], this is always valid if there is a hit.
The index of the shape within the physics object that first detected the hit specifically.
